description: Canada: can I retire at 60 with $500k (or any age and pot)? Year by year to 95 for one person or a couple: RRSP contributions until retirement, RRSP to RRIF (by 71) with the RRIF minimum withdrawal, CPP from the chosen age (−0.6%/month before 65, +0.7% after), OAS from 65-70 (years in Canada / 40, +0.6%/month deferred, +10% at 75) with the 15% recovery tax over $95,323, GIS on last year’s income, pension income splitting, an optional UK State Pension (frozen in Canada), and federal plus provincial tax for every province and territory except Quebec (2026 amounts). Returns the age the money lasts to, bridge years, wealth at retirement, the spending that lasts to 95, a retire-at-60/62/65 comparison and key years in today’s money.
